# Kuray Karaaslan — kuray.dev

> Personal portfolio and engineering blog by Kuray Karaaslan, a Software Architect & Product Engineer based in Turkey, also working as a BIM developer and IoT developer (React, Next.js, Node.js, Java Spring Boot). Focus areas: multi-tenant SaaS architecture, BIM automation (Autodesk Revit/AutoCAD/Advance Steel), IoT telemetry systems (MQTT, SNMP, WebSocket), and developer experience.

## About

- Role: Software Architect & Product Engineer — also a BIM developer and IoT developer
- Stack: React, Next.js, React Native, Node.js, TypeScript, Java Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Redis
- BIM: Autodesk Revit, AutoCAD, Robot Structural Analysis, Advance Steel; API automation with C# and PHP REST APIs
- IoT: device-to-server communication over MQTT, WebSocket, and SNMP
- Location: Turkey (remote-friendly)
- Languages: English, Turkish
- Available for freelance and consulting work
